summary: Backend-only testing of Daily Tracker FYP prototype. 14 pytest tests covering health, auth (register/login/me + duplicate/401), staff CRUD + role-based access, holiday CRUD with year filter, and attendance create + upsert + month/agent filter. All 14 tests PASSED against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Returns 200 on success instead of 201 (Created) — minor REST convention nit, not a functional bug.
Use 200 instead of 201 on resource creation — minor REST convention nit.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is non-spec; browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Works for current testing but should be tightened to explicit origin list for production.
RegisterRequest restricts role to ['user','guest'] which prevents accidental admin self-registration (good). Just calling out as intentional.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — works on current FastAPI but flagged as deprecated; consider lifespan handler.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: switch resource-creation endpoints to HTTP 201; replace CORS wildcard + credentials with explicit origin list; migrate to FastAPI lifespan API.
critical_code_review_comments: bcrypt hashes verified (format $2b$ produced via bcrypt.hashpw + gensalt) — auth playbook compliant.
seed_admin is idempotent and updates password if .env changes — playbook compliant.
All Mongo handlers correctly strip `_id` via *_from_doc helpers and get_current_user — no ObjectId leakage.
JWT secret loaded via os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] (fail-fast if missing) — good.
Role-based protection enforced via require_admin dependency on POST/PUT/DELETE for staff & holidays. Verified 403 for non-admin user.
Attendance upsert keyed by (agent_id, date) with unique compound index — correctly preserves the same `id` on update.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; will break browser auth flows from real origins.
Single 460-line server.py — acceptable for prototype scope but should be split into routers/models/services if the app grows.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (auth playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails). Acceptable for FYP prototype, but flag if production hardening is required.
No httpOnly cookie set on login — auth uses Bearer-token-only flow per the stated design (token in localStorage). Login response only returns the token; that matches the chosen architecture.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@dailytracker.com / admin123 (auto-seeded). test_credentials.md is empty aside from comments — main agent should populate it with the admin creds for future runs.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created by tests. All TEST_ prefixed staff/holidays/attendance created during tests are cleaned up via DELETE in the same test. A few throwaway test users (test_*@example.com / user_*@example.com / dup_*@example.com) are left in the users collection — not cleaned up because the API has no admin delete-user endpoint. Recommend main agent add a cleanup script or admin user-delete endpoint if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Public base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. JWT via Authorization: Bearer <token>. Admin: admin@dailytracker.com/admin123. Seeded staff: A001-A004 active, R001 resigned. Holidays seeded for current year (6 records). Attendance upsert keyed on (agent_id, date). Next agent should focus on frontend testing (calendar UI, staff management, holidays, auth flow) when requested.
